string.name: settings_city_hint
string.value: e.g. weathercn:101010100. Copy from the desktop app or use Auto-locate.

string.name: settings_alert_hint
string.value: Alerts whose title contains these keywords will not notify. Leave empty to notify all.

string.name: settings_session_hint
string.value: Two devices sync only with the same session ID. Letters, digits, underscores only, up to 128 chars.

string.name: settings_background_hint
string.value: When enabled, the app keeps computing the schedule and firing reminders in the background. On devices that disallow long background residency, it falls back to foreground-only; other features are unaffected.

string.name: settings_no_plugins_hint
string.value: No extensions installed. Extensions are declarative: a JSON manifest declaring components, triggers and actions, which appear in the panel and automation after installation.

string.name: settings_reset_confirm
string.value: All settings will return to their initial values, including reminder advance times and automation profiles.

string.name: ruleset_no_data
string.value: This platform has no data for this rule; treated as false.

string.name: ruleset_group_empty
string.value: No rules chosen in this group; the whole group is skipped.

string.name: ruleset_group_disabled
string.value: This group is disabled and does not participate.

string.name: ruleset_skipped
string.value: Not evaluated (an earlier rule already decided).

string.name: ruleset_no_groups
string.value: No rule groups yet; this content will always show.

string.name: ruleset_all_groups_disabled
string.value: All groups are disabled; this content will always show.

string.name: ruleset_result_hint
string.value: The result was computed when this page opened; re-evaluate after the schedule changes.

string.name: ruleset_reversed_hint
string.value: Reverses the result after evaluating all groups (desktop: Ruleset.IsReversed).

string.name: ruleset_disable_hint
string.value: When disabled, this group does not participate; its settings are kept.

string.name: ruleset_rule_order_hint
string.value: Order of rules within a group does not affect the result

string.name: ruleset_expression_hint
string.value: Like the desktop version, no segment-reuse flag; a malformed expression is treated as no match.

string.name: ruleset_no_group_hint
string.value: No rule groups yet. Add one before adding rules.

string.name: pane_use_local_time
string.value: When off, uses the device time directly

string.name: pane_seconds_hint
string.value: Only takes effect when seconds are hidden

string.name: pane_vague_rain_hint
string.value: Hide exact remaining minutes during long rain

string.name: pane_alert_meta_hint
string.value: Alert title style and weather data source use desktop defaults; not configurable on HarmonyOS yet.

string.name: pane_schedule_notes
string.value: Add a note next to each time

string.name: pane_dim_hint
string.value: Unlike hiding, this only dims them

string.name: pane_rule_pause_hint
string.value: Rule-based pause and stop will be configurable here after rule evaluation (P8) lands.

string.name: pane_slide_rule_hint
string.value: Switch mode and rule-based pause/stop will be configurable here after rule evaluation (P8) lands.

string.name: pane_container_no_settings
string.value: This container has no settings of its own; configure the components inside.

string.name: pane_separator_no_settings
string.value: The separator has no configurable items.

string.name: pane_name_placeholder
string.value: Leave empty to use the component name

string.name: pane_hide_by_rules_hint
string.value: Hidden when the rules hold. Evaluation uses the schedule at the moment the page opened.

string.name: pane_extra_fields_hint
string.value: Unlisted fields keep the values written on desktop; nothing is lost on round-trip.

string.name: temp_overlay_desc
string.value: An overlay schedule is a temporary modification over another schedule (e.g. changing P.E. to self-study this week). When the master switch is off, overlay schedules are completely ignored.

string.name: temp_overlay_off_hint
string.value: When off, all overlay schedules are inactive

string.name: temp_source_stale
string.value: The overlay source is stale; this schedule is not used

string.name: temp_pick_expiry
string.value: Pick an expiry time; selection returns to normal afterwards.

string.name: temp_group_pick_msg
string.value: Pick a strategy and expiry time.

string.name: temp_no_schedule
string.value: No schedules yet. Create one in "Schedule".

string.name: temp_temporary_desc
string.value: Pick a schedule to temporarily take over; it expires automatically.

string.name: temp_group_desc
string.value: Temporarily take over with an entire group. Schedules in the group follow their own rules, so different days may map to different schedules.

string.name: temp_booked_desc
string.value: Booking lets a specific day use another schedule, e.g. exam day. Past days are marked as expired but not auto-removed — they stay in the profile and sync along.

string.name: edit_group_dissolved
string.value: Schedule group dissolved; schedules moved to default group

string.name: edit_group_deleted
string.value: Schedule group deleted along with its schedules

string.name: edit_timelayout_deleted
string.value: Time layout deleted; linked schedules unbound

string.name: tl_no_timelayout
string.value: No time layouts yet. Schedules need a bound time layout to arrange classes.

string.name: tl_no_schedule_uses
string.value: No schedule uses this time layout yet.

string.name: tl_unused_safe
string.value: No schedule uses this time layout; deleting it affects nothing.

string.name: tl_no_periods
string.value: This time layout has no periods yet.

string.name: cp_no_timelayout_first
string.value: Create a time layout in "Time Layout" first

string.name: cp_no_schedule
string.value: No schedules yet. A schedule defines what class is on which day.

string.name: cp_timelayout_stale
string.value: The bound time layout no longer exists; this schedule is not used. Re-bind one in "Time Layout".

string.name: cp_disable_hint
string.value: When disabled it is not selected, but the schedule itself is kept

string.name: cp_edit_class_hint
string.value: Tap a subject name to change it. Turning off the right switch marks the class as off (e.g. a swapped class).

string.name: cp_timelayout_no_periods
string.value: The bound time layout has no periods yet; add some first.

string.name: cp_overlay_children_affected
string.value: overlay schedules based on it will also lose their overlay relationship.

string.name: ct_hide_rules_hint
string.value: When the rules hold, this whole row is hidden. Independent from the component-level rules.

string.name: ct_no_components
string.value: This row has no components yet

string.name: cl_duplicate_hint
string.value: Creates a new scheme with identical content; it is only saved to disk after renaming.

string.name: cl_preview_hint
string.value: Shows the current layout. Schedules come from the saved file, so unsaved edits in the editor are not reflected here.

string.name: cl_scheme_hint
string.value: On desktop this lives under "Component config scheme" in settings, matching the same-named file under the desktop config directory.

string.name: cl_reload_confirm
string.value: This discards all unsaved changes and reloads from disk.

string.name: cl_no_rows
string.value: No rows yet. Add a row before adding components.

string.name: cl_add_row_top
string.value: Add a Row at the Top

string.name: rm_biweekly_note
string.value: The schedule has biweekly schedules, but system reminders fire every week — for such weeks, trust the schedule.

string.name: rm_nothing_to_remind
string.value: The current schedule has no classes to remind

string.name: rm_use_system_hint
string.value: Uses the system reminder, ringing once before class by the advance time below

string.name: rm_advance_indoor_hint
string.value: For ordinary classroom classes; one ring is enough to head back

string.name: sub_no_subjects
string.value: No subjects yet. Add subjects before arranging classes.

string.name: sub_name_placeholder
string.value: One or two characters shown in the schedule

string.name: sub_no_classes_use
string.value: No classes reference this subject yet.

string.value: Cannot read the panel layout; the file may be corrupt. What you see is not saved.

string.name: clv_cannot_move_into_self
string.value: Cannot move: a container cannot be moved into itself or its own children

string.name: rsync_disable_failed
string.value: Failed to disable; try again later

string.name: rsync_no_permission
string.value: Notification permission is off; allow this app to send notifications in system settings

string.name: rsync_read_failed
string.value: Could not read existing reminders; nothing was changed

string.name: rsync_slot_limited
string.value: The system provides too few reminder slots; this app can schedule at most 30

string.name: sysspeech_create_failed
string.value: Failed to create system speech engine

string.name: speech_no_engine
string.value: No usable speech engine on this device

string.name: ew_delete_periods_hint
string.value: After deleting, these classes become empty; the rest is unaffected.

string.name: time_off_use_system
string.value: Precise time is off; using system time.

string.name: imp_no_manifest
string.value: No manifest.yml in this package; it does not look like a ClassIsland plugin package.

string.name: imp_no_id
string.value: No Id in manifest.yml; cannot tell which plugin this is.

string.name: imp_dotnet_note
string.value: The desktop plugin code is a .NET assembly; this platform does not load it, so it provides no entries.

string.name: exec_run_unavailable
string.value: Action "Run Program" is unavailable on HarmonyOS

string.name: exec_plugin_empty_notice
string.value: The extension notification title and body are both empty; nothing to send.

string.name: exec_weather_no_data
string.value: No weather data yet; wait for the next refresh

string.name: eh_temp_desc
string.value: Temporary switch, overlay adjustment, booking a day

string.name: eh_import_export_hint
string.value: Import replaces the entire draft. Export saves what you currently see (including unsaved changes).

string.name: cgp_desc
string.value: Schedule groups switch schedules by dimensions like biweekly or term. The selected group is the only one used for selection.

string.name: cgp_delete_hint
string.value: Use "Delete" to remove the schedules along with it.

string.name: ed_reload_confirm
string.value: This discards all unsaved changes and reloads from disk.

string.name: ws_no_data
string.value: No weather data yet; pull down or tap "Refresh Now" to retry

string.name: ddo_no_session
string.value: Enabled, but no session ID yet

string.name: pp_no_visible_rows
string.value: This scheme has no visible rows

string.name: pp_add_row_hint
string.value: Add a row above and the panel will have content

string.name: wf_cond_editor_pending
string.value: Condition editor: reuses RulesetEditorView (not wired yet)

string.name: wf_cond_off
string.value: Conditions are off; the workflow fires unconditionally

string.name: fws_unavailable
string.value: Desktop service is temporarily unavailable; the card will update on next wake

string.name: settings_volume_hint
string.value: Follows the system media volume (system TTS does not support separate adjustment)

string.name: settings_alert_icon_hint
string.value: Not loaded: alert icons are remote images over plain HTTP
